descriptions.tsonnet_c30_turn_advance_8021c74c: When the pending flag at offset 92 is set and the CurrentTeamIndex property names a team whose word at offset 32 is zero, increments a step counter in the owner's linked record and, once it exceeds the limit at offset 124, clears an engine word, sets a state bit, calls a virtual release, leaves the current screen if requested, posts an integer message and an empty message and clears the flag; field meanings are inferred.
